item.title: Seven Lessons from Restaurant Gigs: How Volume and Pacing Taught Me About Playing for the Room
item.author: mockingbirddevin@gmail.com (Devin Frank)
item.description: Seven lessons from restaurant performing: volume management, song choice evolution, reading the room, knowing when to stop. Practical insights on early/mid/late dining energy, dynamic range, and serving the room.
item.content:encoded:
Real-world notes on reading the room, managing volume and energy, and making choices that serve the space instead of showcasing yourself.

Topics covered: early/mid/late dining energy management, dynamic range, frequency balance, song selection, knowing when to stop, and adapting to different restaurant atmospheres.

7 minute read. Published Jan 29, 2025.

item.title: Why I Chose the Numa X Piano 73: A Practical Keyboard Review from a Working Musician
item.author: mockingbirddevin@gmail.com (Devin Frank)
item.description: Keyboard selection rationale: piano quality, organ sounds, portability at 73 keys, build quality, connectivity. Honest pros/cons assessment and real-world use context in a solo live rig.
item.content:encoded:
Why I chose the Studiologic Numa X Piano 73 for solo performances: honest assessment of piano sounds, organ capabilities, portability, connectivity, and fit within my live rig.

Covers: piano quality, organ sound palette, 73-key portability, build and feel, MIDI integration, and realistic use cases. Good fit for piano-based music, NOT for deep synthesis exploration.

10 minute read. Published Jan 22, 2025.

item.title: Building a Practical Solo Rig: From Simplest Setup to Recommended Configuration
item.author: mockingbirddevin@gmail.com (Devin Frank)
item.description: About building solo musician rigs: keyboards, mixers, speakers, supporting gear. Topics: simplest setup vs. recommended setup, speaker configuration, acoustic guitar DI, backing tracks.
item.content:encoded:
Step-by-step guide to building a portable, reliable rig for solo performances. Covers the absolute basics, then a recommended production-quality setup.

Topics: simplest setup, keyboard/mixer/speaker configuration, acoustic guitar direct injection, backing track systems, and the actual rig I use: Numa X Piano 73, CQ-20B mixer, 2x EV Evolve 50M speakers, plus supporting equipment.

8 minute read. Published Jan 15, 2025.
